title: Warm Crispy German Potato Hash
description: A citrusy and crispy German dish featuring cumin, perfect for a brunch mood, made with whole30-friendly ingredients. This recipe is a delicious and healthy twist on traditional hash browns.
instructions: Grate the potatoes and onions, and squeeze out as much moisture as possible using a paper towel or clean dish towel.
In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes and onions, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the potato mixture to the skillet, and press down with a spatula to form a flat layer.
Cook the hash for 5 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown and crispy.
Flip the hash over, and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the other side is also golden brown and crispy.
Remove the hash from the skillet, and stir in the lemon juice and chopped parsley.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
